title: Solfeggio and the conservatory at the French Opera
summary: He learned solfeggio at school and studied violin around age seven at a Saturday conservatory class.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: How did you learn your solfeggio? Is that what you learned?
Well, hadn't you learned it before that, though, at all?
Well, sure. I, they sent me to the Milano Conservatory in the old French opera.

Oh, and how? What age? Well, I was just a kid, I guess about seven years old. They had an old gang of kids learning to play at that time, and there was a little fellow lived up on Richard Street. I can't think of what his name is right now, but he and I, we led the field. We, we were in a class by ourselves. So we used to go on Saturday morning early because of the fact that there's only two of us capable of, uh, staying in that class. The rest of them, uh, didn't advance as fast as we did.
Well, at that, uh, class you went to, uh, was it still, uh, learning how to read and all that, or did you actually play music?
Oh, no, we didn't play. No, at that time I was learning violin. Fiddle. Sure.
